holdoutRule: Among open upstream issues about source generation or analyzers, with reproduction code, excluding the four samples, choose updated_at descending (number descending breaks ties). Fetch open issues in updated-descending order; examine until the first eligible issue. If the attempt produces no diff, select the next eligible issue. One fresh-context author attempt per selected issue, maximum 40 minutes.
eligibility: Generator/analyzer topic must be stated in title/body; reproduction code must be present in the issue body (not merely a linked project or error log).
controlRule: Merged upstream PRs ordered by merged_at descending (number descending breaks ties), merged_by.type User, closing an issue, touching src/MessagePack.SourceGenerator/ and tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/. Use the original PR comparison. Exclude known reverts; clean is only an assumption. If it cannot build in the pinned container, record and try next, at most three.
humanRecords: No signoffs, confirmations, spotchecks, finding marks or escape records will be created by the agent.
